arguments.sql:
WITH louisiana_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT id_bioguide
    FROM main.legislators_terms
    WHERE state = 'LA'
),
term_profiles AS (
    SELECT t.id_bioguide,
           COUNT(DISTINCT t.state) AS state_count,
           MIN(t.term_start) AS first_start,
           MIN(CASE WHEN t.state = 'LA' THEN t.term_start END) AS first_la_start
    FROM main.legislators_terms AS t
    JOIN louisiana_ids AS i ON i.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    GROUP BY t.id_bioguide
)
SELECT
    (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT l.gender) FROM main.legislators AS l
     JOIN louisiana_ids AS i ON i.id_bioguide = l.id_bioguide) AS gender_codes,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM louisiana_ids) AS louisiana_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM term_profiles WHERE state_count > 1) AS multistate_ids,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM term_profiles WHERE first_start <> first_la_start) AS first_term_outside_la,
    (SELECT MIN(term_start) FROM main.legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA') AS earliest_la_start,
    (SELECT MAX(term_end) FROM main.legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA') AS latest_la_end,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA' AND (term_start IS NULL OR term_end IS NULL)) AS la_terms_with_missing_dates,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.legislators_terms WHERE state = 'LA' AND SUBSTR(term_end, 6) = '12-31') AS la_terms_ending_dec_31,
    MIN(d.date) AS first_calendar_dec_31,
    MAX(d.date) AS last_calendar_dec_31,
    COUNT(*) AS calendar_dec_31_rows
FROM main.legislation_date_dim AS d
WHERE d.month_name = 'December' AND d.day_of_month = 31;

WITH RECURSIVE offsets(n) AS (
    SELECT 31
    UNION ALL
    SELECT n + 1 FROM offsets WHERE n < 49
), first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_start
    FROM main.legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
), snapshots AS (
    SELECT t.id_bioguide, t.term_end, o.n,
           printf('%04d-12-31', CAST(substr(f.first_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + o.n) AS snapshot
    FROM main.legislators_terms AS t
    JOIN first_terms AS f ON f.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    JOIN main.legislators AS l ON l.id_bioguide = t.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN offsets AS o
    WHERE t.state = 'LA' AND l.gender = 'M' AND snapshot BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end
)
SELECT MIN(s.snapshot) AS earliest_snapshot,
       MAX(s.snapshot) AS latest_snapshot,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.n) AS occupied_offsets,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN d.date IS NULL THEN s.id_bioguide END) AS ids_outside_date_dim,
       COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN s.snapshot = s.term_end THEN s.id_bioguide END) AS ids_serving_on_term_end
FROM snapshots AS s
LEFT JOIN main.legislation_date_dim AS d ON d.date = s.snapshot;

WITH RECURSIVE elapsed_years(years_since_first_term) AS (
    SELECT 31
    UNION ALL
    SELECT years_since_first_term + 1
    FROM elapsed_years
    WHERE years_since_first_term < 49
),
first_terms AS (
    SELECT id_bioguide, MIN(term_start) AS first_term_start
    FROM main.legislators_terms
    GROUP BY id_bioguide
),
year_end_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        f.id_bioguide,
        y.years_since_first_term,
        printf(
            '%04d-12-31',
            CAST(substr(f.first_term_start, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) + y.years_since_first_term
        ) AS snapshot_date
    FROM first_terms AS f
    JOIN main.legislators AS l ON l.id_bioguide = f.id_bioguide
    CROSS JOIN elapsed_years AS y
    WHERE l.gender = 'M'
),
active_legislators AS (
    SELECT s.years_since_first_term, s.id_bioguide
    FROM year_end_snapshots AS s
    JOIN main.legislators_terms AS t
        ON t.id_bioguide = s.id_bioguide
        AND t.state = 'LA'
        AND s.snapshot_date BETWEEN t.term_start AND t.term_end
)
SELECT
    y.years_since_first_term,
    COUNT(DISTINCT a.id_bioguide) AS legislator_count
FROM elapsed_years AS y
LEFT JOIN active_legislators AS a
    ON a.years_since_first_term = y.years_since_first_term
GROUP BY y.years_since_first_term
ORDER BY y.years_since_first_term
LIMIT 1000
